evidence: Plaut. Cas. 148: St! tacē atque abī.
Plaut. Ps. 952b: St, tacē, aedēs hīscunt.
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “hist! whist! hush!”. Mostly followed by tacē or tacēte; it also serves as the whispered “psst!” before a secret: Dīcis? st! invēnī nūper quandam. (Ter. Haut. 597).

terms.grammar: imperative of taceō, singular and plural

phrases.english: Shh! Quiet, and off you go.
Shh, quiet, cheer up, both of you.

sources: Lewis & Short: st · Lewis & Short: taceo
